item.title: Residents evacuated after fire in Murray apartment building
item.description: Residents have been evacuated from an apartment building after a fire on the second floor, displacing six units.

item.title: Hole dug under Trax line in Murray, allegedly by same person who tunneled under I-15 in September
item.description: Officials have discovered a hole dug under a Trax overpass in Murray, which they say was dug by a man who is already facing charges for digging a tunnel under I-15 in September.

item.title: Heber City man arrested for waterboarding 16-year-old daughter, police say
item.description: A Heber City father is behind bars after police investigated reports that he was "waterboarding" his 16-year-old daughter.

item.title: Governor Cox responds to international reporters asking about political tension and Trump's remarks on US Olympic skier
item.description: Utah Governor Spencer Cox was at a press conference in Milano Cortina Tuesday, speaking about the state's vision for the Winter Games in eight years, when international reporters asked Cox about political tensions and President Donald Trump's Truth Social post about a U.S. Olympic skier.

item.title: Assisted living manager charged with stealing resident's credit card info, spending over $26,000
item.description: A manager at an assisted living facility has been charged with allegedly taking a resident's credit card information and spending over $26,000.

item.title: Police investigate after pedestrian hit, killed by vehicle in Tooele
item.description: A Pedestrian was hit and killed by a car at Main Street, causing the road to be closed to all southbound traffic.

item.title: New state law cracks down on illicit massage businesses in effort to combat human trafficking
item.description: A new state law aimed at cracking down on illicit massage businesses is going into full effect in March. The state hopes this will help combat human trafficking.

item.title: Wild turkey hit by car in Rose Park brings up larger frustrations in community with traffic
item.description: After one of the wild Rose Park turkeys was hit and killed by a car, residents are expressing their larger frustrations with traffic in the neighborhood.

item.title: Company behind yearbook photos for Weber County Schools, others has connections to Epstein Files
item.description: Some of the Epstein files connect a company that takes photos for school yearbooks across the country, including in Weber County. Some parents are concerned, but the district said they've investigated and found no wrongdoing.

item.title: Much needed winter weather returns for the mountains with alerts in effect
item.description: We are finally getting some mountain snow! Winter Weather Advisories are in effect for many of our mountains across the state for the first time in over a month.
